firstLaunch.introSwitch: {{brand}} keeps your ratings, collections and edits in a catalog. Your photos stay where they are — the catalog only describes them.
firstLaunch.headingFolderLost: The catalog folder cannot be reached
firstLaunch.introFolderLost: The folder holding your catalog was moved or renamed, or the browser forgot its permission for it. Pick it again — nothing inside it is lost.
firstLaunch.headingNoDurable: This browser cannot store anything permanently
firstLaunch.introNoDurable: {{brand}} finds neither a place inside this browser nor a way to a folder. Whatever you do in this session is gone when the tab closes. A current Chrome, Edge or Firefox fixes that.
firstLaunch.multiDeviceHub: Using more than one device? Sign in to {{origin}} under Settings → Storage. The sync server keeps ratings and edits in step across your devices; the photos themselves stay on each device.
firstLaunch.multiDeviceOwnServer: More than one device needs a sync server of your own. A catalog in iCloud, Dropbox or on a network drive will not do: every device rewrites the whole catalog file, so the second one overwrites the first one’s work.
firstLaunch.introFirstRun: {{brand}} keeps your ratings, collections and edits — your photos stay untouched, where they are. Pick where those notes should live; you can change it later at any time.
firstLaunch.tierTrialDesc: The catalog stays inside the browser, nothing to set up. In exchange the browser may clear this storage whenever it likes — in Safari after seven days without a visit. Fine for a look around, not for a library meant to stay.
firstLaunch.tierTrialDescMemory: This browser cannot store anything permanently. Everything you do is gone when the tab closes.
firstLaunch.tierFolderDesc: The catalog sits in a folder you choose — visible in your file manager, and backed up whenever you back that folder up. Only one device and one tab may have it open at a time.
firstLaunch.tierFolderUnavailable: Needs Chrome, Edge, Brave or Opera — Safari and Firefox give web pages no access to folders.
firstLaunch.tierServerDescNoAddress: Ratings and edits live on a server of your own and stay in step across several devices. You need its address, an account on it, and it has to be reachable from the internet — one only your home network can see will not do. The photos themselves stay on each device.
firstLaunch.tierServerDescKnown: Ratings and edits live on {{origin}} and stay in step across several devices. The photos themselves stay on each device.
firstLaunch.tierServerSignInNote: You sign in afterwards under Settings → Storage. Until then the app keeps working in browser storage.

about.appDescription: Professional photo management and RAW development in the browser. Inspired by Capture One and Adobe Lightroom.
about.appSubDescription: WebGL-accelerated image editing with a non-destructive workflow. All edits are stored locally — no cloud required.
about.copyright: © {{year}} Sebastian Bernhard. Free software under the GNU AGPL v3 (AGPL-3.0-only).
about.licensesIntro: {{brand}} ships the following open-source components to your browser.
about.licensesFullBody: The full text of each licence used here:
about.githubIntro: The public repository holds the source code and is the place for bug reports, requests and questions.
about.githubSource: The source code is published there under the GNU AGPL v3. Code contributions (pull requests) are not accepted; bug reports and ideas are welcome.
about.githubUseHeading: What it is used for right now
about.githubUseBug: Report a bug — with steps, source and browser.
about.githubUseDuplicate: Browse existing entries first and back one with a thumbs-up rather than opening a duplicate.
about.githubLanguage: German is as welcome as English.
about.licNote_libraw-wasm: Contains LibRaw, which is licensed under LGPL-2.1 or CDDL-1.0. Source and licence text at the project above, LibRaw at libraw.org.
about.licNote_libheif-js: Included as the unmodified WebAssembly build. The source is at the project above, where the build can be obtained and replaced.
about.licNote_scunet: Only downloaded once denoising is actually used.
about.privacyIntro: What happens to your data when you use {{brand}}. The controller is the person named in the imprint.
about.privacyWhereBody: Catalog, EXIF data, previews, edits, settings, presets, collections and the connections to your sources are kept in this browser's storage (Origin Private File System, IndexedDB, localStorage). You remove them by clearing the site data in your browser.
about.privacyDeliveryBody: The application is delivered through Cloudflare and a server at our hosting provider. Both process your IP address to transmit the page. {{brand}} itself keeps no access log. The server holds only the program files, never your photos.
about.privacyLocalBody: Photos from local folders never leave your browser. They are read and developed there. You grant access through the browser's permission prompt and can revoke it at any time.
about.privacySourcesBody: If you connect your own server such as Immich or Lychee, your browser talks to that server directly. Address and credentials are kept in this browser's storage and are sent only to that server.
about.privacySourcesSelfhost: In the self-hosted version, requests to your sources can go through the {{brand}} server, which may cache downsized RAW previews.
about.privacySyncBody: If you set up sync, edits, ratings, collections and catalog data go to the address you enter yourself. Photos are never transferred, and the credentials of your sources are removed before sending.
about.privacyNoTrackingBody: {{brand}} sets no cookies and uses no analytics or tracking tools.
about.privacyRightsBody: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection, and to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority. The full privacy policy is on the website.

storage.heading: Storage
storage.hint: Where do sources, ratings and edits live? You can switch at any time — nothing moves with you, each storage keeps a catalog of its own.
storage.opfsActiveSub: The browser manages the space — and may reclaim it at any time.
storage.opfsInactiveSub: No folder dialog. Gone when site data is cleared, and reclaimable when storage runs short.
storage.memoryActiveSub: Everything is gone when the tab closes — please download the catalog.
storage.memoryInactiveSub: Only for this session. Gone when the tab closes.
storage.compactTitle: Rewrite thumb-bin files and drop old/unindexed entries
storage.memoryWarn: Memory mode — everything is gone when the tab closes. Download the catalog and load it back into a folder, or switch there right away.
storage.resetChoiceTitle: Reset choice, ask again on next start
storage.resetLocalSettingsTitle: Delete every locally stored setting; catalog, photos and edits stay
storage.resetLocalSettingsConfirm: Reset all local settings? Catalog, photos and edits are kept. The page reloads afterwards.
storage.removeEncryptionConfirm: Really remove encryption? The catalog will be stored in plaintext.
storage.encryptCatalogTitle: catalog.sqlite will be encrypted with AES-GCM over PBKDF2
storage.encryptDialogDesc: AES-GCM with PBKDF2-SHA256 (600k iterations). Min. 12 characters. Forgotten = lost — no recovery.

server.heading: Server (optional)
server.hint: Optional: your own UnifyRAW server over HTTPS. The server has to allow this address in CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, otherwise the browser blocks every call.
server.consequences: A server set here takes over decoding and transport: RAW files are uploaded to it for developing, and the access token is kept in this domain's storage.
server.label: Server address
server.checkBlocked: The browser gives no reason. Three are possible: {{origin}} is missing from the server’s CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, the server sits on a private network (which this page may not enter), or it cannot be reached.
server.reasonMixedContent: This page runs over HTTPS and may not talk to an http:// server. A certificate alone does not settle it for a server at home, though: the browser also forbids the way from a public page into a private network over HTTPS.
server.reasonOwnOrigin: That is this page's own address; no server sits there to answer.
server.reloadHint: The change takes effect after a reload.
server.selfhostNote: This build talks to its own server; an override is for special cases only.
server.checkNotOurs: Something answers there, but it is not a UnifyRAW server ({{detail}}). Does the address point at the app instead of the server?

storage.syncHint: Keep multiple devices in sync — the server only stores edits + metadata, no images.
storage.registrationManagedByAdmin: Accounts are provisioned by the server administrator.
storage.sessionExpired: This session has expired or was ended on another device — please sign in again.
storage.resendAllHint: Sends the whole catalog to the server again, in case a device misses older changes. The server keeps the newer version of each entry.
storage.readOnlyLocked: This catalog is open in another tab. This tab only reads it — changes made here are not saved.
storage.lockFree: The other tab has released the catalog. Reload to work with it here.
storage.flushFailed: Changes could not be saved ({{name}}). Retrying on its own — download a snapshot if this persists.
storage.importCatalogTitle: Put a backed-up .sqlite back into this storage. Thumbnails are rendered again afterwards.
storage.importConfirm: Load this catalog? It holds {{photos}} photos and replaces the catalog sitting here ({{current}} photos). Thumbnails will be rendered again.
storage.importNotSqlite: That is not a SQLite file. Expected a .sqlite of the kind “Back up catalog” writes.
storage.importNotCatalog: The file is a SQLite database, but not a catalog of this app.
storage.importNewerSchema: This catalog comes from a newer version (format {{version}}). This version would damage it on the next save — please update the app first.
storage.folderUnreachable: The catalog folder cannot be reached — please pick it again.
storage.switchLeavesBehindConfirm: Really switch? The catalog in “{{label}}” with {{photos}} photos stays where it is; it does not come along. The new storage starts empty. Switching back finds it again.
storage.persistenceGranted: Yes — only you can delete this storage
storage.persistenceBestEffort: No — the browser may reclaim this storage
storage.calloutTrial: Your catalog sits in browser storage — the tier for trying things out. The browser may clear it at any time; if the library is meant to stay, pick a folder or a server of your own.
storage.calloutFolder: Your catalog sits in a folder on this computer. Back that folder up and the catalog is backed up with it.
storage.calloutServer: Ratings and edits stay in step with your server. What sits in the browser is only a copy now — lose it and the next sync brings it back.
storage.calloutServerPending: The server address is set, but nobody has signed in yet — until then everything sits in browser storage only. Sign in under “Sync” below and the catalog starts syncing.

hub.checkBlocked: The browser gives no reason. Three are possible: {{origin}} is missing from the hub’s CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, the hub sits on a private network (which this page may not enter), or it cannot be reached.

hub.publicHint: The hub has to be reachable from the internet. One that only your home network can see is off limits to this page, whatever certificate it carries.

editor.rawDecoderHint: How should RAW files (.CR2, .CR3, .NEF, .ARW, .RAF, .DNG …) be decoded in the editor? Changes take effect the next time a RAW is opened. RAWs from local folders are always decoded locally in the browser regardless.
editor.smartPreviewHint: Larger previews = more editing headroom and detail at 1:1 zoom, but more storage and a longer first view. Changes invalidate existing caches (regenerated lazily).

heifModes.jpeg: 8 bit via JPEG — default, fastest loading
heifModes.linear16: 16 bit linear — full depth, RAW path, most headroom

editor.heifHint: "8 bit via JPEG" re-encodes the image before editing — fast, but with compression loss. "Lossless" delivers the same 8 bits without that loss, but costs a slower PNG encode. "16 bit" reads the full depth of the file (10 bit on most cameras) and uses the same path as RAW, including the smart preview size above. If the 16-bit path fails, it falls back to 8 bit automatically. HLG/PQ footage can get wrong tones at 16 bit — switch to 8 bit then.
editor.pregenerate: Pre-generate smart previews for all RAWs
editor.pregenerateHint: Generates smart previews for all RAWs in your library in the background. Afterwards every editor open is instant. Briefly loads the server (max. 2 parallel decodes).
editor.rawCacheHint: Smart previews live locally in the browser OPFS (origin-private file system). Cleared caches are regenerated automatically the next time the editor opens.
editor.iccHint: Uploaded ICC profiles (e.g. display calibration from X-Rite/Calibrite). Currently only storage is supported — pixel conversion follows in a later version. Max {{used}}/5 profiles.

cache.heading: Memory
cache.gridBufferHint: Rows preloaded above/below the visible area
cache.noFsAccessHint: This browser does not support the File System Access API. Sidecar data only lives in the LocalSource folder. Switch to the Storage tab to use the new catalog mode.

stale.title: Orphaned photos
stale.hint: Photos in the catalog that no longer exist in their source (e.g. Immich). They are detected on use (400/404 from the server). Here you can remove them from the UnifyRaw catalog.
stale.none: No orphaned photos detected in this session.
